mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as reduced borrowing costs boost equity valuations and corporate investment.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals economic distress that triggers immediate risk aversion, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the mean return difference from baseline is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates conflicting supply-demand signals that disrupt economic stability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (INDPRO change * HOUST change) has Rank IC < 0.03 for 20-day returns over any 3-year window, or the negative return pattern fails to materialize in > 40% of interaction events.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals aggressive monetary tightening that suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 3.5% periods, FEDFUNDS > 4.0% fails to predict negative 60-day returns with Rank IC < 0.03, or the return difference from baseline is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for RSAFS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between RSAFS and returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad consumer sector slowdown that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST change * RSAFS change) has Rank IC < 0.03 for 20-day returns over any 3-year window, or the negative return pattern fails in > 40% of interaction events.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals labor market overheating that may trigger inflation and rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%, or the mean return difference from baseline is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production (INDPRO) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it signals immediate economic contraction that reduces near-term earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between INDPRO and returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
